name: CVin.Bio MCP Server
description: Search curated tech jobs and query platform stats from CVin.Bio via MCP. Read-only, no authentication required.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search curated tech jobs by keyword, company name, or location. Returns matching listings with title, company, location, and cvin.bio URL.

query.description: Search term — skill, company, location, or role title.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one curated tech job listing by id. Returns title, company, location, salary when listed, and the canonical cvin.bio URL.

tools.name: platform_stats
tools.description: Live counts of curated jobs, hiring companies, and public candidate profiles on CVin.Bio.

api.rate_limits: RateLimit-* headers on API responses; Retry-After on 429
